check.command: node --check js/app.js && node --check js/i18n.js && node --check js/theme-init.js && node --check js/background.js && node --check js/config.js

branchName.instructions: Prefix branches with feat/ or fix/ and a short kebab-case description (e.g. fix/sports-refresh, feat/rss-filter). No personal prefixes.

commitMessage.instructions: One short sentence describing the change (e.g. newtab: add RTL marquee). Releases are separate commits titled vN.N.N: <summary>.

pullRequest.instructions: Describe what changed and why. Link related issues. For UI changes attach before/after screenshots. No personal data in screenshots or logs.
